system_rank_inversions.explanation: Physics-IQ rewards clean empty backgrounds after a straight-line sprite shoots off-screen early, whereas foresight audit penalizes early border exits and mid-table pass-throughs.

Stopped-track endpoint error stops measuring whenever omni drops or blurs the object (36/60 vanished, 33/60 duplicated); counting vanished objects against fixed-horizon reality flips the error ordering.

Stopped-track endpoint error stops measuring whenever genie drops or blurs the object (7/60 vanished, 11/60 duplicated); counting vanished objects against fixed-horizon reality flips the error ordering.
